subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw accept per-agent managed plugin installs now, and must the first implementation include the complete scoped install/uninstall/discovery/security contract before merge?
rationale: This adds a public plugin CLI flag and persisted install-record shape that affects plugin code execution and agent isolation, so maintainer product/security intent is required before accepting the API boundary.

options.title: Require Complete Lifecycle
options.body: Accept the direction only after the PR covers scoped install, uninstall, update cleanup, agent validation, shared config preservation, docs, and security proof.

options.title: Pause For Design Issue
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue as the design vehicle and pause or close this PR until maintainers settle the durable contract.

options.title: Accept Install-Only Risk
options.body: Merge the install-only first cut knowing scoped records may be hard to remove and lifecycle semantics will remain inconsistent until follow-up work lands.

recommendation.title: Require Complete Lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the direction only after the PR covers scoped install, uninstall, update cleanup, agent validation, shared config preservation, docs, and security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The history trail ties this surface to prior plugin install tracking and persistence design work, and the open choice is mainly the durable product/API contract.
